name: Winter Outfit Towers! [Would You Rather] ❄️
desc:
❄️ Welcome to Would You Rather: Winter Outfit Towers! ⛄

Choose a door and build your perfect winter outfit one choice at a time. ♡

Every doorway gives you something new:
🧸Cozy winter outfits, hair and accessories
💀Or something that could completely RUIN your outfit

Climb through 4 winter towers with different styles and see what your final outfit looks like at the top!

🤍Every run gives you different items, play again for a new outfit!

❄️Features aesthetic music and cozy decoration

❤️ LIKE + FAVORITE for more outfits and updates!

llm.loop: choose between two doors -> each grants a winter outfit item or a ruinous one -> climb through 4 towers -> see final outfit at the top -> replay for a new outfit
llm.objectives: build the best winter outfit by the top of the tower
llm.instructions: choose a door, build your outfit, climb 4 winter towers
unique: would-you-rather doors that dress your avatar
llm.thumbnails: two doors labelled with winter clothes and a question mark; a cozy-dressed character
llm.complexity_notes: door choice towers with accessory randomization
